entries.description_zh: 甲状腺局部O-information年龄效应：各信号up/down/flat GSEA曲线
entries.inputs: restored gseapy.gene_set.prerank.report.csv, prerank_data.rnk, gene_sets.gmt; historical PDF names only select terms
entries.input_nature_zh: 原入口读取回归表及extracted_signals.tsv，重新按年龄相关性分类bins、构建基因集并做GSEA置换；不是纯作图。此次仅读冻结report/RNK/GMT。

checks: Every historical PDF name mapped to one saved report term.
Every running ES recomputed from full saved ranks/GMT with error <= 2e-6.
Saved NES, P and FDR retained; no new null distribution/permutations.
Every PNG decoded and every PDF header/EOF verified.
notes: Only CSV/RNK/GMT intermediate files restored. Historical images were not copied or read.
Custom matplotlib rendering replaces library styling while preserving full curves, hits, ranked metrics and saved statistics.
Enrichment plots were originally conditional on library plotting criteria; all 120 region/library outputs are audited, including those with zero historical curves.
